name: ENKI Node Type Vocabulary Pack
description: Canonical node type taxonomy. v0.8.1 (2026-07-08): Tier-1 (Gate A) additive extension — general-aboutness `topic` subtypes (event, relationship, aspect, legal, reference, theme) so Wikipedia-style topics ('Death of X', 'Relationship of A and B') have a home alongside the intelligence-domain subtypes; appended after `investigation` so existing base-60 positions are unchanged. v0.8.0 (2026-05-14): adds the `library` category (topic-anchored addressable subgraphs that drive the OSINT discovery loop — discover references via bibliographic indices, acquire PDFs, ingest, extract facts, harvest citations) plus `document.bibliographic_reference` and `source.bibliographic_index` subtypes. v0.7.0 adds the `definition` category. v0.6.0 adds `lemma` subtype. v0.5.0 adds the `form` category. See the internal base60 cyclical language model notes.

metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.change_control: New node types or subtypes via Tier 1 vocabulary extension (Gate A). Removing a type requires full ceremony (Gate A+B+C) and migration plan for existing nodes.
